name: Studio Object
concept: A rendered object is the page; the interface shrinks to hairline pills docked around it.

type.families: Neo-grotesque or geometric sans, weight-alternating within a single headline (one clause light, the next semibold).
type.hierarchy: Headline 44/48 with mixed weights · body 15/23 regular · label 11/14 medium ALL-CAPS 0.1em · single display numeral up to 120px when the object is a metric.
type.usage: Alternate weight inside one headline rather than using colour or size for emphasis. Keep all UI type small — the render should dominate.

tokens.texture: The object is the page. A single matte 3D render — a sphere in liquid, an isometric building, a device — fills most of the frame, lit softly in a grey studio. UI reduces to hairline pill buttons and small floating micro-panels docked to the render, often with thin leader lines connecting a label to a point on the object. Surfaces are matte; no gloss, no neon.
tokens.layout: Composition over structure. The render occupies 60-75% of the viewport; content is docked to one edge or floats over a quiet area of the image. 8px scale, 999px radius on pills, 12px on micro-panels, 16px padding. Hairline leader lines (1px, `--line`) tie annotations to the object.

image_recipe.template:
[SUBJECT: describe the subject in one clause — e.g. "a stack of shipping containers", "a single ceramic cup", "an abstract network of nodes"]

Rendered as matte 3D product render, grey seamless studio.

STYLE — apply all of the following, they are not optional:
- flat mid-grey #D6D6D6 seamless background with soft falloff
- one object centred, matte finish, no gloss or chrome
- soft large key light from above-left, gentle contact shadow
- near-monochrome with at most one small colour note
- orthographic or mild isometric projection

NEGATIVE SPACE: At least 30% flat grey ground on one side for docked UI and type.

DO NOT INCLUDE: glossy or reflective materials, coloured lighting, busy scenes, photographic backgrounds, neon, dramatic contrast.
